title: NATO's answer to a Russian nuclear strike on Ukraine: the first 72 hours (simulation)

strikes.launch_name: Russian Iskander-M brigade, Kursk region (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: Ukrainian reserve staging area, open farmland, central Ukraine (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Simulation choice: one low-yield airburst on a military assembly area in open farmland, no city and no nuclear plant near. Carrier: Iskander-M, the system analysts and CFR name as most likely for a battlefield strike (research A12). Yield 20 kt is a simulation choice inside the published 10 to 100 kt envelope for Iskander warheads (A12, single-source, so 'up to' wording); Hiroshima about 15 kt is only a yardstick (A13). Airburst. All NATO moves in the episode are simulation choices, conventional and diplomatic (A23 to A25). Different site and yield from episode 005 on purpose.
